authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner maṣi/masi explicitly records Oriya masi ink and the wider Indo-Aryan soot/black-powder family (Pali masi soot, Gujarati masī soot). Bhatri məsi elicited for smoke is a plausible soot-for-smoke semantic response; this is a family comparison, retaining the original survey gloss and not asserting that Turner recorded Bhatri.

proposals.evidence: Turner *kuha fog/mist lists Hindi kuhrā/kuherī, neighbouring kuhīṛ/kuhur and Oriya kuhuṛi. These Bagheli/Bhatri smoke responses are compared with the fog/haze family, with the elicited smoke sense preserved. Forms with an additional nasal cluster or unexplained l are not included.
